comments.why: Zeihan's talk to pig farmers with credible observations on globalization
comments.text: My (recent) introduction to Zeihan was this talk he gave to pig farmers. [VIDEO] The audio is a little rough, but it's worth the watch (in my opinion). Yeah, he comes across as a bit forward and a bit nationalistic, and clearly not every prediction is going to land, but I think he's got some really good observations and seems fairly credible. Better at least than most of the talking-heads you see on the news.
